Make the firstmate study's internal references resolve. (1) Change the places-held counter's changed_by list or the t9 card and claims so they agree. If t9 frees or keeps a place, cite the claim that says so on the t9 card; if it does not, remove t9 from changed_by. (2) Rewrite finding f2 so that it names only page sections that exist; the page has no 'concurrency entry'. Add a study validation check that fails when a counter lists a transition whose card and claims share no claim with the counter, and when a finding names a page section that is not rendered.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Study page points at things it does not show: counter lists t9 but t9's card never mentions places; f2 names a missing 'concurrency entry'
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
